content:
Isabella’s sum is
\[
S_I=\frac{ab(ab+1)}2.
\]
Vidur’s sum is
\[
S_V=\left(\sum_{i=1}^a i\right)\left(\sum_{j=1}^b j\right)
=\frac{a(a+1)}2\cdot \frac{b(b+1)}2
=\frac{ab(a+1)(b+1)}4.
\]
Thus
\[
S_I-S_V
=\frac{ab(ab+1)}2-\frac{ab(a+1)(b+1)}4
=\frac{ab(a-1)(b-1)}4.
\]
Since the difference is \(1200\),
\[
\frac{ab(a-1)(b-1)}4=1200
\]
so
\[
ab(a-1)(b-1)=4800.
\]
Let \(x=a-1,\ y=b-1\). Then
\[
x(x+1)y(y+1)=4800.
\]
Testing factors gives \(x=4,\ y=15\), so \(a=5,\ b=16\). Hence
\[
a+b=21.
\]
\[
\boxed{21}
\]
